scientific_integrity: The count uses maximal periodic intervals with least period, not letter runs. Exact formulas follow by the stated gap and generating-function arguments. Standalone Python 3 checking code is included.
scientific_limitations: Only finite linear binary words with exactly three ones; no assertion for cyclic words or larger weights. Historical search cannot establish categorical uniqueness. Exhaustive checks are finite supplements to the proof.
title: Exact run spectrum of binary words with three marked ones
